text:
sara: FYI seeing dedicated pool 'eu-west-2-pool-7' bounce between 2/8 and 6/8 nodes, customers hitting 429s and elevated p50. Logs show autoscaler toggling because queue depth metric spikes then drops. Opening a ticket with eng-sre.

mike: @sara can you paste the metric graphs + the scale decision logs? Is this noisy neighbor or control loop instability?

sara: here's short dump:
```
scale_decision: up to 6 at 2026-03-16T14:02Z reason=queue_depth>threshold(75)
scale_decision: down to 2 at 2026-03-16T14:03Z reason=cpu<30
scale_decision: up to 6 at 2026-03-16T14:04Z reason=queue_depth>threshold(75)
```

jamal: that looks like hysteresis too low + metric jitter. What's the cooldown config on this pool? :thinking:

sara: cooldowns are 60s scale_up/30s scale_down per pool config.

mike: aha, scale_down cooldown shorter than upstream stabilization window. Suggest bump scale_down -> 180s and add moving-average on queue_depth (60s).

elaine-support: customer BrightCart reported 429s and billing spikes; they're escalating. Any radius for retrofitting canary breaker? They asked for repro steps.

jamal: repro: send steady burst 200 RPS for 90s then drop to 20 RPS. Pool oscillates. Add this script:
```
#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..90}; do seq 1 200 | xargs -n1 -P50 curl -s -o /dev/null https://redwood-prod.example/api/generate; sleep 1; done
```

mike: let's also enable the temporary circuit-breaker to reject low-priority tenants when pool >80% busy. I'll push patch to autoscaler to require *both* queue_depth and sustained CPU>50 for 30s.

sara: rolling patch to canary pool now. keeping @oncall-bot on watch. :eyes: 

oncall-bot: deploy start: autoscaler/scale-policy-20260316 canary -> eu-west-2-pool-7

oncall-bot: deploy success (canary) 2026-03-16T15:10Z

elaine-support: Customer confirmed drop in 429s during canary window. Can we schedule change for all pools this evening? They want fix before morning.

jamal: schedule at 23:00 UTC, remind ops to monitor latency and billing delta.

sara: noted. I'll update incident ticket and add repro steps + mitigation notes. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
